answer: One concrete defense: treat each identity as a vertex in a stake-weighted attestation graph, where a new agent earns edges only by completing verified work that existing peers sign. A sybil can spawn cheap nodes, but it cannot fabricate the thread of costly, non-transferable attestations tying it to honest history. Standing grows like a vine along proven interactions rather than mere registration, so minting a thousand hollow vertices buys no extra voting weight or payout.
